note: Official briefing videos that tools/refresh_transcripts.mjs turns into AI transcripts. Official publishers only: a government body's own channel or a government media hub, never a news outlet, state media, a mirror or an aggregator. Each video is read where the body itself published it (no logins, proxies or spoofed clients). A transcript is the speaker's claim, never a finding. Telegram channels are named here and their country, kind and language come from tools/social_accounts.json, so the two lists never disagree. Added 2026-11-23.

dvids.note: DVIDS (Defense Visual Information Distribution Service), the US Department of Defense's media hub. Its videos are US government works (public domain) with a direct MP4 on its own CDN. Only titles that name a briefing, press conference, news conference, media availability, press gaggle or remarks are taken, not B-roll or features.

telegram_note: Official government channels whose public web preview (t.me/s/<channel>) shows the video file itself. Videos Telegram marks too big for the preview are skipped, not fetched another way.
